{{Top|leg}}
'''Fent Jucalla''' was a mining overseer working on [[Ruhnuk]] on behalf of the [[Gatressa Mining Conglomerate]] by the time of the [[Ruhnuk Mining Disaster]] in [[3663 BBY]]. During the disaster, she prioritised the lives of the miners over the recovering of equipment.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Catastrophe on Ruhnuk}}</ref>
